name: Tank Wars
author: Shimon Ulewicz
description: A 3D tank battle: hit the other tanks with your shells to score, and the first to 10 points wins. Up to 4 players with several gamepads.

descriptions.en: A 3D tank battle: hit the other tanks with your shells to score, and the first to 10 points wins. Up to 4 players with several gamepads.
descriptions.it: Battaglia di carri armati in 3D: colpisci gli altri carri con i proiettili per fare punti; vince chi arriva prima a 10. Fino a 4 giocatori con più joypad.
